title: Microsoft Reports $10 Billion Revenue From OpenAI
excerpt: Microsoft generated $10 billion from commercial arrangements with OpenAI in the quarter ending September 30.
body_html:
Microsoft disclosed that it brought in $10 billion in revenue stemming from commercial agreements with OpenAI. The total, which includes revenue-sharing payments, was recorded for the quarter ending September 30.

This financial figure highlights the substantial ongoing monetary relationship between the two companies as their partnership continues to develop.
